title: Version Calculation Cache Keys
teaser: Old results must not survive an algorithm change as if they were current.
full_text: Include the algorithm version in calculation cache identity and verify a version bump cannot return a stale result for the same inputs.

title: Keep Backup Identities Locale Independent
teaser: Changing language must not break restore matching.
full_text: Create a package under Turkish then open it under English and verify table and enum identities resolve independently from display text.

title: Format PDF Dates at Presentation Time
teaser: Canonical date storage and visible formatting should remain separate.
full_text: Generate the same report under Turkish and English and confirm the source date identity stays fixed while only presentation changes.

title: Do Not Reinterpret Birth Instants After Timezone Changes
teaser: A stored UTC instant must not drift with the device timezone.
full_text: Open one saved profile under two device timezones and verify the calculation core receives the exact same instant value.

title: Return Safely from a Free Lock Screen
teaser: Closing a paywall should not corrupt navigation state.
full_text: Enter a gated feature then back out without purchase and confirm the previous valid screen and domain state remain intact.

title: Normalize Negative Zero in Chart Degrees
teaser: Negative zero should never leak into UI or exports.
full_text: Exercise a boundary fixture that produces -0.0 and verify UI PDF and CSV all expose canonical zero.

title: Match Accessibility Labels to Visible Meaning
teaser: Assistive text must not describe a different action than the screen.
full_text: Scan primary cards for visible-title and semantic-label pairs and fail tests when their meanings diverge.

title: Show Destructive Restore Impact in Preview
teaser: Replace mode should disclose what will change before mutation.
full_text: Load a backup against existing data and verify preview counts for added changed and removed records match the real diff.

title: Carry Night Planetary Hours Across Midnight
teaser: Night segments must not restart on a new civil date.
full_text: Generate the post-sunset twelve-part sequence and confirm ruler order continues correctly through midnight.

title: Deduplicate Location Search by Stable Identity
teaser: One dataset record should not appear twice through different aliases.
full_text: Search by local and English names and verify matching aliases collapse to one stable location ID without losing metadata.

title: Exclude Internal Fields from Journal Export
teaser: Runtime-only metadata should not leak into user CSV files.
full_text: Export a journal entry and confirm internal flags and schema plumbing fields are absent from the public export contract.

title: Do Not Unlock PRO for Pending Purchases
teaser: Access must wait for a verified transaction state.
full_text: Process a pending purchase fixture and verify the entitlement resolver remains Free until the documented verification signal arrives.

title: Validate Aspect Grid Symmetry from Source Data
teaser: Visual mirroring must not hide incorrect calculations.
full_text: Query planet pairs in both directions and confirm mirrored grid cells carry the same aspect identity and orb magnitude.

title: Prevent Double Submit During Loading
teaser: A slow save must not launch a second mutation.
full_text: Trigger a delayed repository save twice and verify only one transaction and one resulting record are created.

title: Do Not Promise Backup Encryption Unless Implemented
teaser: Product language must match the real security model.
full_text: Audit backup help and settings copy against package behavior and verify no unsupported encryption claim is shown.

title: Centralize Numerology Master Number Policy
teaser: Reduction of 11 and 22 must not vary by module.
full_text: Run life-path and period fixtures through one shared reducer and verify the contracted master-number behavior everywhere.

title: Record EOP Source Dates in Evidence
teaser: Astronomy results need reproducible data provenance.
full_text: Match provider source epoch and checksum metadata exactly between calculation manifests and release evidence.

title: Honor User Selected PDF Section Order
teaser: Chosen sections should not be forced back into template order.
full_text: Select three report sections in a custom sequence and verify parsed headings follow the same selection order.

title: Document the BaZi Hour Pillar Time Standard
teaser: Identical clock input should not silently use different time conventions.
full_text: Store the hour-pillar timing rule in the calculation manifest and verify fixtures reproduce results under the selected standard.

title: Require Confirmation for Irreversible Deletes
teaser: A destructive action without undo must not fire from one tap.
full_text: Trigger permanent client deletion and verify repository mutation cannot occur before explicit destructive confirmation completes.

title: Preserve Form Data When Locale Changes
teaser: Switching language must not erase an in-progress draft.
full_text: Change locale on a populated birth form and verify name date time and location retain the same domain values.

title: Reject Unknown Required CSV Columns Explicitly
teaser: Schema drift should fail visibly before data changes.
full_text: Import a file with an unsupported required column and verify validation stops before any row mutation with a clear schema error.

title: Sort Transit Timelines by Canonical Instant
teaser: Local wall-clock order can lie during DST folds.
full_text: Use a transit fixture across a repeated local hour and verify ordering follows canonical instants while labels remain correct.

title: Expose Locked Controls as Disabled Semantics
teaser: A PRO gate should not sound like an active button to a screen reader.
full_text: Inspect a gated action in Free state and verify disabled semantics and lock explanation are both present.

title: Resolve UUID Conflicts Deterministically on Restore
teaser: Merge mode must not split one identity into two records.
full_text: Merge datasets containing the same UUID with different update times and verify the documented conflict rule yields one stable result.

title: Compare Release Asset Hashes with Runtime Manifest
teaser: Packaged files must match repository provenance.
full_text: Hash critical SVG font and catalog assets inside the build artifact and compare them exactly with versioned manifest values.

title: Keep Daily Message Theme Tags Internal
teaser: Editorial classification keys are not user-facing copy.
full_text: Render daily-message cards across several themes and verify only localized title and content appear while internal tags remain hidden.

title: Scan April Against All Historical Exact Text
teaser: New copy should not repeat an older year verbatim.
full_text: Compare April title teaser and full_text fields against every committed English shard and reject the batch on any exact collision.

title: Run Near-Duplicate Review Within Each Locale
teaser: Translation similarity across languages should not create false alarms.
full_text: Partition similarity analysis by locale and verify only same-language candidate pairs enter the editorial review queue.

title: Advance April Coverage Only After Commit
teaser: Generated but unstored content must never count as reviewed coverage.
full_text: Reload both April shards from main verify 30 canonical dates per locale and record 2035-05-01 as the next exact start.
